text:
Ibrahim: FYI — another noisy run from kv-cache this morning, three pages in ~10m. Opening follow-up so we don't keep redoing the same fixes. Incident: https://incidents.redwood/11234
Faye: saw it. pattern looks like the same post-deploy blip we've seen ~monthly. dedupe rules didn't collapse because identity tags differ per shard.
Liu: can you paste the alert rule? want to see eval window + for: settings.
Ibrahim: rule excerpt below:
```
alert: kvcache_error_spike
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_errors_total[1m])) by (shard,region) > 40
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kvcache
```
Anika: two things we should try in tandem:
- increase eval window to 4-5m
- change dedupe identity to (service,deployment) and add an intentional suppression/backoff so repeated identical alerts within X minutes are collapsed
Liu: also recommend a short backoff that increases with repeated flaps: e.g., mute repeated pages from same identity for 10m after 3 pages in 6m, and extend to 30m if it continues. that reduces fat-finger noise while still catching sustained outages.
Ibrahim: sounds good. who can own the infra-alerts PR?
Faye: I can take ownership of the PR and add unit tests for suppression logic. ETA EOD today.
Anika: i'll own the runbook update + paging policy language (we should say: <7m resolves -> ticket; >=7m sustained -> page; critical signals still page immediately).
Liu: i'll add a telemetry metric: dedupe_savings:counter and pages_blocked:counter so we can show impact after rollout. will sync with observability team. ETA next week.
PagerDutyBot: alert kvcache_error_spike triggered 2026-04-12T03:37:12Z -> pages:3, resolved 2026-04-12T03:48:01Z, link: https://incidents.redwood/11234
Faye: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/523 — changes: eval_window:5m, for:2m, dedupe labels -> service+deployment, suppression/backoff policy, severity toggle for canary envs. includes unit tests and CI. PTAL @Liu @Anika
Liu: reviewing now. small nit on metric name, otherwise LGTM.
Ibrahim: rollout plan: merge to main, canary to staging for 6h, then gradual prod roll 5/25/70. monitor pages and pages_blocked metric for 7d.
Anika: will add explicit exceptions in runbook for known deploy windows and a runbook step to temporarily silence if we expect noise.
Faye: merged and deployed to staging. CI green.
Ibrahim: staging 6h: 0 pages, pages_blocked:2 (expected). scheduling prod rollout tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
Liu: opened observability ticket: https://issues.redwood/obs/4090 to wire dedupe_savings, ETA next sprint.
Anika: action item recap:
- Faye: PR + tests (done)
- Liu: metrics + obs ticket (next sprint)
- Anika: runbook + paging policy wording (tomorrow morning)
- Ibrahim: validate post-deploy and close postmortem loop (7 days)
Ibrahim: nice work. let's review noise numbers in the next oncall retro. ping me any regressions here. :thumbsup:
